gloss: general affairs; clerical work; miscellaneous office duties

definitions.gloss: general affairs; clerical work; miscellaneous office duties
definitions.explanation: The various routine administrative tasks in an office or organization that do not fall under a specific specialized department. Includes tasks like document management, supply ordering, facility maintenance coordination, and other day-to-day operational support.

examples.japanese: {庶務|しょむ}{担当|たんとう}に{聞|き}いてください。
examples.english: Please ask the person in charge of general affairs.

examples.japanese: {入社|にゅうしゃ}してすぐ{庶務|しょむ}{課|か}に{配属|はいぞく}された。
examples.english: Right after joining the company, I was assigned to the general affairs section.

examples.japanese: {備品|びひん}の{管理|かんり}や{来客|らいきゃく}の{対応|たいおう}など、{庶務|しょむ}の{仕事|しごと}は{多岐|たき}にわたる。
examples.english: General affairs work covers a wide range, including managing supplies and handling visitors.

notes:
Refers to the catch-all category of administrative and clerical work in an organization. {庶務|しょむ} tasks are the behind-the-scenes operational duties that keep an office running smoothly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {庶務|しょむ}{課|か}: general affairs section/department
- {庶務|しょむ}{担当|たんとう}: person in charge of general affairs
- {庶務|しょむ}{係|がかり}: general affairs clerk
- {庶務|しょむ}{業務|ぎょうむ}: general affairs duties

TYPICAL TASKS:
{庶務|しょむ} includes tasks such as:
- {備品|びひん}{管理|かんり}: managing office supplies
- {書類|しょるい}{整理|せいり}: organizing documents
- {来客|らいきゃく}{対応|たいおう}: receiving visitors
- {電話|でんわ}{応対|おうたい}: answering phone calls

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {総務|そうむ}: general affairs (at a higher organizational level; a department name)
- {事務|じむ}: office work, clerical work (broader and more general)
